rows.label: bf03330100_0010
rows.name:
And then I saw the power of darkness
swallowing everything.

rows.label: bf03330100_0020
rows.name:
People and Divine Beasts alike were
swallowed into a vortex of darkness.

rows.label: bf03330100_0030
rows.name:
At this rate, the world will end.
It will all come to an end!

rows.label: bf03330100_0040
rows.name:
But then, wounded all over, my master, the hero Adel,
rose and made his decision.

rows.label: bf03330100_0060
rows.name:
Power to banish the dark! Power
to illuminate the world!

rows.label: bf03330100_0070
rows.name:
Oh! You are Heaven's Holy Grail,
a servant of God!

rows.label: bf03330100_0080
rows.name:
Please, grant me power!
Bring light to this world!

rows.label: bf03330100_0090
rows.name: And so, the darkness was driven away.

rows.label: bf03330100_0110
rows.name:
Many continents sank
beneath the Cloud Sea.

rows.label: bf03330100_0120
rows.name:
O servant of God... Thanks to you,
the world has been saved.

rows.label: bf03330100_0130
rows.name:
I shall atone for the
price paid by your life.

rows.label: bf03330100_0140
rows.name:
I shall pass down your legend...
Together with my name, forever...
